name: OmniFlow Master: Distribution & Cross-Platform Analytics Loop
description: End-to-end autonomous social content engine. Ingests video assets, executes scheduled 3-channel distribution (TikTok + YouTube Shorts + Instagram Reels), registers publication records, and schedules recurrent analytics synchronization.

nodes.name: Schedule Posting Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires at 9:00 AM, 1:00 PM, and 5:00 PM EST daily (peak social engagement windows).

nodes.name: Instant Publish Webhook
nodes.notes: Allows external headless CMS, Airtable, or Notion to push video distribution requests immediately.

nodes.name: Fetch Pending Queue & Media
nodes.notes: Normalizes raw content into platform-compliant formats (char limits, hashtags, and titles).

nodes.name: TikTok Open API - Init Video Post
nodes.notes: TikTok Content Posting API v2. Ingests video via PULL_FROM_URL directly into TikTok creator library.

nodes.name: TikTok - Await Transcode
nodes.notes: Allows TikTok video transcoding cluster to ingest and generate final media publish ID.

nodes.name: TikTok - Fetch Publish Status
nodes.notes: Confirms PUBLISH_COMPLETE or queries errors.

nodes.name: YouTube Data API - Upload Short
nodes.notes: Initiates resumable upload for YouTube Shorts vertical stream with public status & category 22.

nodes.name: YouTube - Parse Video ID
nodes.notes: Extracts YouTube video ID and forms permanent Shorts watch link.

nodes.name: Instagram Graph - Create Reel Container
nodes.notes: Step 1 of Meta Instagram Reels API: Ingests video URL into Instagram media creation container.

nodes.name: Instagram - Ingestion Wait
nodes.notes: Meta requires asynchronous transcoding time before media_publish can be executed.

nodes.name: Instagram - Poll Container Status
nodes.notes: Verifies status_code === 'FINISHED' before triggering media_publish.

nodes.name: Instagram - Media Publish
nodes.notes: Step 2 of Meta Instagram API: Commits container ID to active user feed and Reels shelf.

nodes.name: Merge Multi-Platform Outputs
nodes.notes: Harmonizes platform publication identifiers into single record for analytics tracking.

nodes.name: Store to Central Content DB
nodes.notes: Appends the 3 platform IDs into central registry so the Analytics Harvester can monitor performance.

nodes.name: Discord / Slack Dispatch Alert
nodes.notes: Broadcasts confirmation cards to the growth marketing team channel.

nodes.name: Recurring 6-Hour Harvester
nodes.notes: Executes every 6 hours to capture organic trajectory and virality curves.

nodes.name: Query 30-Day Published Registry
nodes.notes: Fetches all content entries dispatched within the last 30 days containing platform IDs.

nodes.name: TikTok - Video Query Stats
nodes.notes: Retrieves TikTok real-time view_count, like_count, comment_count, and share_count.

nodes.name: YouTube - Video Statistics API
nodes.notes: Fetches YouTube viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, and duration.

nodes.name: Instagram - Media Insights API
nodes.notes: Meta Graph Insights for Reels: returns reach, plays (views), saves, shares, and interactions.

nodes.name: Cross-Platform Normalizer & Scoring Engine
nodes.notes: Computes total cross-channel views, blended engagement rate %, platform leader, and viral flag.

nodes.name: Append Time-Series Performance Row
nodes.notes: Preserves snapshot data for longitudinal growth curves and weekly reporting.

nodes.name: Check Viral Breakthrough
nodes.notes: Evaluates if post has crossed viral velocity threshold for immediate team alert.

nodes.name: Send Viral Breakout Notification
nodes.notes: Sends high-priority notification to growth team when a video exceeds engagement targets.

main.node: TikTok Open API - Init Video Post
